title: Gumball Adjusts to Window Projection
description: The 3D gumball must adjust to the window projection. Planar views (orthographic Plan/Top/Bottom/Front/Back/Left/Right, and other drafting-locked planar projections) show only the in-plane gumball subset: the two in-plane move/scale axes, the view-plane move/scale handle, and rotation about the view normal. Non-planar projections (axonometric, perspective, etc.) keep the full 3D gumball. Implement once at the shared gumball + world-projection layer so puzzle 3d, cad, and every world host inherit it.
summary:
Planar window projections now show a drafting-plane subset of the 3D gumball instead of the full widget.

Added `GumballConfig.plane` (`xy`/`yz`/`xz`) and per-handle filtering in `UnifiedGumball` (in-plane move/scale axes + view-plane handles + rotation about the view normal + uniform). Mapped projections via `worldProjectionGumballPlane` / `orbitCameraViewGumballPlane` in infinite-world-r3f. World host intersects transform mode with projection through `worldGumballConfigForProjection`; CAD panes apply the orbit-view plane to the active gumball config. Axonometric / multi-point / perspective keep the full 3D gumball.

Verified: ui-react UnifiedGumball math, infinite-world-r3f worldProjectionGumballPlane, framework-renderer-react worldGumballConfigForProjection.
